data.one_liner: Grafana Faro SDK for Flutter applications to collect telemetry and monitor performance.
data.what_it_does: The Grafana Faro Flutter SDK enables real user monitoring (RUM) for mobile applications by instrumenting Flutter apps to collect telemetry. It captures device information, application details, performance metrics, errors, user interactions, and HTTP network monitoring.
use_when: You want to monitor Flutter app performance and track errors using the Faro protocol.
You need to capture user sessions, interactions, and HTTP network telemetry.
avoid_when: You require an official dedicated mobile observability product from Grafana.
You need custom transports that act as replay destinations for cached offline telemetry.
strengths: Automatic capture of Flutter errors and exceptions.
Built-in offline support with caching of events when offline.
Tracks performance metrics including CPU, memory usage, and ANR detection.
weaknesses: GrafanaFrontend Observability is built for web applications and there is no dedicated mobile observability product from Grafana.
Custom transports are no longer replay destinations.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency and initializing Faro in your application entry point, with optional HTTP overrides configuration.
